scope: x402 List measured listed-service facilitator flow; not total x402 ecosystem
limitations: Gross arithmetic scenario is not an addressable market estimate: no evidence AgentMine can capture any listed settlement flow.
Flow outside top ten is computed from publisher rounded top-ten share; result has corresponding rounding uncertainty.
Top service flow is imported and dominated by one address; addresses are not verified people or paying businesses.
Method: net per listed address, excludes self-payments and avoids per-service sum; do not compare historical volumes unless method and coverage are aligned.
No observed AgentMine buyers, conversions, costs, margin or revenue.
decision: Do not prioritize a generic 1% transaction-fee exchange on this evidence alone. Validate a narrow buyer workflow (Supplier Growth) and real willingness to pay before building payment rails.
